environment.description: Kubernetes deployment running the Kafka consumer with PostgreSQL 15. The database user specified in DATABASE_URL is 'order_processor' which has direct INSERT and UPDATE privileges on the 'orders' table. No row-level security policies are enabled on the orders table. The consumer processes messages from a shared Kafka topic where multiple upstream services (including a partner-facing API) can produce events. The database connection uses a single role without any session-level policy enforcement.

config.table_grants: INSERT, UPDATE, SELECT ON orders TO order_processor
